_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-35 base rate on ±2-point moves makes HOLD the statistically honest call — the coil has not broken and neither brain has produced a confirmed breaker signal yet.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — both are structurally bullish but the analyst explicitly hedges with low conviction while the narrative assumes the breakout is underway
next_move.confirmed_if: funding climbs above 0.006% with stablecoin_growth crossing 55 and btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d falling below 85
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed drops below 25 with VIX spiking above 80 and etf_flows falling below 70, or any single 12h window showing score drop of 3+ points
